init_mock_datastore: initialize a MockDatastore instance with a datastore root path and create SQLite tables
ensure_requester_exists: create a requester record in the mock datastore if it does not already exist
set_requester_registered: set the registration status of a requester to true or false in the mock datastore
set_worker_blocked: set the blocked status of a worker to true or false in the mock datastore
set_unit_expired: set the expired status of a unit to true or false in the mock datastore
